name: PLEX - Enrich Claim
description: Runs when a PLEX_ClaimAssignments row is created or modified, and after CSV ingestion. Derives the PL_ flags from rulesv1.2.json + assignmentRulesv1.0.json and stores PL_Bucket. Skips excluded claims.

trigger.type: SharePoint - When an item is created or modified

actions.note: Group by ListName into an object of arrays

expressions.PL_ALS: any term in als is a whole-word match in VeteranFlash or SpecialIssues
expressions.PL_BWN: any term in bwn is contained in VeteranFlash, SpecialIssues or SpecialMission
expressions.PL_Homeless: any term in homeless is contained in VeteranFlash
expressions.PL_Terminal: any term in terminal is contained in VeteranFlash
expressions.PL_PurpleHeartOriginal: EPCode in ('110','010') AND any purpleHeart term in VeteranFlash or SpecialIssues
expressions.PL_AttyFee: EPClaimLabel = 'Attorney Fee Memo' OR any attyFee term in VeteranFlash
expressions.PL_Sensitive: '7' if VeteranFlash contains 'Employee Claim'; else '6' if it matches @sensitive; else '0'

actions.note: First match wins, so each claim has exactly one bucket.

actions.connector: SharePoint - Update item (only when a value changed, to avoid trigger loops)
